title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On this coordinate system, create a new face and within this face, draw a single loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.021, 0.021] with a radius of 0.021. Scale the entire 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0421. Ensure that the scaled 2D sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by applying a rotation with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector set to zero. Extrude the scaled 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be a length of 0.04209677419354838 units, a width of 0.04209677419354838 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = workplane.center(0.021, 0.021).circle(0.021)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Display the final model
